name: Minted Spring Pea & Asparagus Soup with Parmesan Crisps
ingredients: 32 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash the asparagus and snap (or cut) off the woody ends. Cut into 1-inch pieces and transfer to a baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and bake in the oven for 10-12 minutes.

To make crisps, line a baking sheet with parchment paper and grate Parmesan cheese. Measure out 1 tbsp of the grated Parmesan and place in a pile on the sheet. Repeat with remaining cheese, keeping the piles a few inches apart.
Place in the oven and bake until lightly browned, 5-7 minutes. Watch carefully because they can burn quickly. Once done, remove from the oven and let them sit for a couple of minutes.
Trim, peel, and mince the shallot and garlic.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
When the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat. Add shallot and garlic. Cook, stirring frequently, until shallots are translucent, 2-3 minutes.
Wash mint. Pick leaves off the stems; discard the stems and finely mince the leaves. Add to pot.
Add peas, broth, salt, and pepper to the pot. Bring to a boil over high heat, then turn down to medium-high. Cook until peas have softened, 4-5 minutes.
Add the roasted asparagus and cream to the soup, reserving some of each for garnish. Using an immersion (hand) blender, purée the soup until smooth.
To serve, ladle soup into bowls and drizzle with more cream. Top with reserved asparagus and Parmesan crisps. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
